summary: Learn to reconcile software entitlements, review SaaS renewals, and prepare licensing evidence. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: IT asset management and software licensing link asset records, software use and purchase entitlements throughout an asset’s lifecycle. For IT asset coordinators, licensing analysts and procurement staff, this course offers a practical method for checking software records against installations and purchase rights. Learners practise reconciling license positions, reviewing SaaS subscriptions and preparing evidence for renewal and audit decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who maintain IT asset records, validate software use, or make purchasing and renewal decisions. It suits foundation-level learners who need a practical working method for connecting discovery, contract, and entitlement information.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with IT purchasing, software subscriptions, or IT service records is helpful. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for the course exercises.
